description: Split a PDF into several: one page per file or the page ranges you choose. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf), exactly 1. Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

ranges.description: Page ranges. Page ranges, comma-separated: '1-3' are pages 1 to 3, '5' only page 5 and '8-' from page 8 to the end. Each range becomes its own PDF. Empty: one PDF per page.

name: split_pdf
title: Split PDF
